newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck says Lipha 96 profit up 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Merck says Lipha 96 profit up 23 pct.

text.p: German drugs and chemicals group Merck said on Tuesday its French unit Lipha made a post-tax profit of 128 million marks, a 23 percent increase on 1995, with turnover up 19 percent at 1.17 billion marks.
Lipha's international business accounted for 65 percent of turnover, with domestic French revenues up 10 percent to 416.1 million marks.
Main revenue-earner was the Glucophage anti-diabetes treatment, contributing sales of 285.4 million marks. Other core areas incude treatment of asthma and circulation problems.
Merck group consolidated turnover in France stood at 935.3 million marks in the year.
